title: The colimit's action is uniquely determined by multiplying at a common finite field.
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an arbitrary scheme $X$. Use the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention] and the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $I$ be the poset of finite intermediate fields $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For a topological ring $R$, write $R_X=p_X^*\underline R$, with $\underline R(S)=C(S,R)$ and pulled-back ring structure [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, det-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. For $n\geq1$, give $B_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n\mathcal O_E$ the discrete topology, where $\mathcal O_E=\{a\in E:|a|\leq1\}$, and put
$$
 T_E=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\bigl((B_{E,n})_X\otimes_{\mathbf Z_X}\mu_{\ell^n,X}\bigr),\qquad
 M_E=E_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}T_E.
$$
Here $\mu_{\ell^n,X}$ is the root sheaf [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], tensor and extension of scalars are sheafified tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and the limit is in $\mathcal O_{E,X}$-modules [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. The action on each finite term is multiplication on the $B$ factor through the quotient $\mathcal O_{E,X}\to(B_{E,n})_X$; its transition is coefficient reduction tensored with $u\mapsto u^\ell$. The scalar-extension map $\mathcal O_{E,X}\to E_X$ is [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield]. Let $\alpha_E:E_X\otimes_{\mathbf Z_X}M_E\to M_E$ be its module action [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].

For $E\subseteq F$, let $i_{E,F}:E_X\to F_X$ be the pulled-back coefficient inclusion [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map, det-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $J_{E,F}:T_E\to T_F$ be the unique abelian-sheaf map whose $n$th projection is induced by $B_{E,n}\to B_{F,n}$ tensored with the identity on $\mu_{\ell^n,X}$ [lem-route-sp-integral-twist-map-exists-unique]. Let $j_{E,F}:M_E\to M_F$ be the unique abelian-sheaf map with the localization normalization
$$
 j_{E,F}(b\otimes t)=i_{E,F}(b)\otimes J_{E,F}(t),
$$
as an equality of maps out of the sheaf tensor $E_X\otimes_{\mathbf Z_X}T_E$ before the balanced quotient [lem-route-sp-rational-twist-map-exists-unique]. No invertibility of $\ell$ on $X$ is assumed.

The maps $j_{E,F}$ have identity and composition laws [lem-route-sp-rational-twist-map-id, lem-route-sp-rational-twist-map-comp]; form their diagram $M:I\to\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\operatorname{Ab})$. Let $Q=\operatorname{colim}_{E\in I}M_E$ in abelian sheaves, with coprojections $\eta_E:M_E\to Q$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Put $A=\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}=p_X^*\underline{\overline{\mathbf Q}}_\ell$, using the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, def-sfb-qlbar-coefficient-ring], and let $c_E:E_X\to A$ be the actual pulled-back inclusions [def-sfb-qlbar-x-cocone]. Then there exists exactly one $A$-module-object structure on the fixed underlying abelian sheaf $Q$ whose action $a:A\otimes_{\mathbf Z_X}Q\to Q$ satisfies, for all $E,F,H\in I$ with $E,F\subseteq H$,
$$
 a\circ(c_E\otimes\eta_F)
 =\eta_H\circ\alpha_H\circ(i_{E,H}\otimes j_{F,H})
 \colon E_X\otimes_{\mathbf Z_X}M_F\longrightarrow Q.
$$
The colimit here is a sheaf colimit, not an assertion that sections over every pro-étale object are a union of sections from finite stages.

proof.text: Let A be the finite-subfield coefficient diagram and M the rational twist diagram. The finite-field poset is filtered by composita [det-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed-subextensions], hence sifted. The rational identity and composition laws [lem-route-sp-rational-twist-map-id, lem-route-sp-rational-twist-map-comp] give M as the specified functor. Form its abelian-sheaf colimit [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaves-filtered-colimits-exact, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The actual coefficient cocone c_A has vertex Qbar_X and is colimiting: use the point coefficient colimit [lem-sfb-qlbar-point-abelian-colimit] and preservation under the left adjoint p_X^* [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point, lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits, def-sfb-qlbar-x-cocone].

proof.text: The stage actions A_E tensor M_E to M_E form a natural transformation A tensor M to M by [lem-sp-rational-twist-transition-semilinear]. Tensor preserves colimits in each variable [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]; since the index is sifted, the tensor of the two colimit cocones is a colimit of the diagonal tensor diagram. Apply its universal property to the stage actions followed by the M coprojections. This gives an action a on the two colimit vertices with (c_E tensor eta_E);a = action_E;eta_E.

proof.text: Check the unit law on the colimiting coprojections of 1 tensor M. Each c_E preserves the unit [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar, det-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and the stage module unit law gives the result. Check associativity on the colimiting triple diagonal tensor cocone (A tensor A) tensor M: multiplicativity of c_E, associator naturality and the stage module associativity law give the desired equation. Thus a is a module-object action [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].

proof.text: For E,F contained in H, the coefficient and twist cocone equations rewrite c_E tensor eta_F as (i_EH tensor j_FH) followed by c_H tensor eta_H [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map, def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]. The diagonal action formula therefore gives exactly the requested common-field formula. Any other action with that formula has the same diagonal composites, by taking E=F=H and using the identity transition maps [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map, lem-route-sp-rational-twist-map-id]. The tensor-colimit hom_ext property identifies its underlying action arrow with a; module-object extensionality gives uniqueness.

theorem spQbarTwistAction_existsUnique :
    ∃! a : ModObj (condensedRingObj.{u} (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj.{u} ℓ) X) (spQbarTwistAb X ℓ),
      ∀ (E F H : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (hE : E ≤ H) (hF : F ≤ H),
        (coefficientMap.{u} (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) X ⊗ₘ
          colimit.ι (spRationalTwistDiagram X ℓ) F) ≫ a.smul =
        (coefficientMap.{u} (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjMap ℓ hE) X ⊗ₘ
          spRationalTwistMap X ℓ hF) ≫
            Mod.act (spRationalTwist X ℓ H).X ≫
              colimit.ι (spRationalTwistDiagram X ℓ) H := by
  sorry
